verdict.rationale: Hightouch's REST API explicitly covers syncs, models, sources, and destinations (hightouch-docs-13, hightouch-docs-33, hightouch-docs-48), and Git Sync lets you manage workspace resources programmatically (hightouch-docs-32), but audience and journey building are repeatedly described as happening in a 'no-code UI' with audiences unable to be created before that step (hightouch-docs-1, hightouch-docs-24, hightouch-docs-35), implying no direct API-only path for that core UI feature. The MCP server (hightouch-docs-10, hightouch-docs-55) lets an AI assistant perform audience/journey/campaign actions via natural language, but this is a distinct conversational interface, not confirmation of raw REST API parity, and no OpenAPI/swagger spec was discoverable (hightouch-probe-3). Missing for 10: documented REST endpoints for audience/journey creation matching UI capability, a public OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation that all UI actions are API-reachable.
